## What

<!-- One topic per pull request. For props: which objects, and which shelf. -->

## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] For props: `npx levni add <file> --sheet check.png`, and the sheet is attached below
- [ ] Name, tags and notes follow [docs/folio-guide.md](../docs/folio-guide.md) (`levni add` prints `note` hints)
- [ ] Own work: not traced from a work, photo, stock image or icon set (say if a chat model wrote the path code)
- [ ] No logos or brand names, no faces, no hands ([BRAND_LOGOS.md](../BRAND_LOGOS.md))
